_comment: Canonical WebSession document shape. client is the authority - it creates and stores this document in SQLite. Web sessions authenticate browser UI connections via passkey or mTLS certificate. A field mismatch breaks session validation, SSE routing, and Operator binding.
_consumers: client internal services (auth, SSE routing, Operator binding)

web_session._description: Authenticated web session for a browser UI connection. Created on successful passkey verification or mTLS certificate enrollment. One session per browser tab.

user_id.description: User ID this session belongs to.

expires_at_unix_ms.description: Absolute expiry timestamp (Unix milliseconds). Session is invalid after this time.

operator_session_id.description: Bound Operator session ID for mTLS certificate auth. Set when session was created via certificate enrollment.

cert_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the mTLS client certificate. Used for revocation checking.

cert_serial.description: Serial number of the mTLS client certificate. Used for revocation checking.

user_agent.description: Browser user agent string for session tracking.

login_method.description: Authentication method used to create this session. See status.json auth.login_method.
